summary: Frontend testing completed for TTRPG LOTR 5e Travel System multi-role and mount features. All 6 features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-role system correctly implemented with papeles[] array instead of single papel string (lines 567, 616)
MULTI_ROLE_PENALTY constant = -5 properly applied in getCharBonus() function (lines 1071-1072)
Mount system shows only character's owned mount via monturaPropia field (lines 555-560, 588-593)
Sin montura propia text correctly displayed when character has no mount (line 1235)
